results.sql: SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year, SUM(i.price) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) GROUP BY year LIMIT 200
SELECT order_status, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY order_status LIMIT 200

SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY(order_delivered_customer_date) - JULIANDAY(order_purchase_timestamp)) AS average_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND NOT order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL LIMIT 200
SELECT payment_type, SUM(payment_value) AS value FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type LIMIT 200
SELECT c.customer_state, AVG(r.review_score) AS average_score FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) JOIN customers AS c USING (customer_id) GROUP BY c.customer_state LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, pc.product_category_name) AS category, SUM(i.price) AS revenue FROM order_items AS i JOIN products AS pc ON i.product_id = pc.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS pct ON pc.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name GROUP BY category LIMIT 200
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders FROM orders AS o GROUP BY month ORDER BY month LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(pc.product_category_name_english, pc.product_category_name) AS product_category, AVG(r.review_score) AS average_score FROM order_reviews AS r JOIN orders AS o USING (order_id) JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) JOIN products AS p USING (product_id) JOIN product_category_name_translation AS pc USING (product_category_name) GROUP BY product_category LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, pc.product_category_name) AS category, c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS pc ON oi.product_id = pc.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS pct ON pc.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' GROUP BY category, c.customer_state ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, pc.product_category_name) AS product_category, SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2017, SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2018' THEN oi.price ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_2018 FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS pc ON oi.product_id = pc.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS pct ON pc.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2017', '2018') GROUP BY product_category LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, pc.product_category_name) AS category, c.customer_state, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue, STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS year FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS pc ON oi.product_id = pc.product_id LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation AS pct ON pc.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_purchase_timestamp) IN ('2017', '2018') AND o.order_status = 'delivered' GROUP BY category, c.customer_state, year ORDER BY category, c.customer_state, revenue DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month, SUM(i.price) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i USING (order_id) GROUP BY month LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LIMIT 200
